about.description: San Carlos is a beachfront family vacation condo rental in Gulf Shores, Alabama. Within walking distance to shops, restaurants, and attractions like The Hangout, Pink Pony, Sea-N-Suds, Gulf Island Grill, Souvenir City, Ribs & Reds, and Mike's Seafood. The complex features a zero-entry outdoor pool, sauna, grilling area, and exercise room with Gulf views.
about.elevator_pitch: A beachfront Gulf Shores condo with direct beach access and family amenities within walking distance to shops, restaurants, and entertainment.
